title: Pre-edit grounding dedupe is defeated by its own delivery receipt: the recent-task reason text flips after the first full injection
observation: injectionMode (src/core/hookcache.ts) hashes the rendered injection. Serving a full block writes a delivery receipt (receipts("served") near src/cli/index.ts:4977); the next pre-edit call's task ranking reads it back through ctx.lastDelivered (src/core/taskRanking.ts ageDays/humanAge, reason text near :224) and the recent-task line changes from 'today' to 'delivered today'. The hash changes and a second full block is sent for the same agent and file. The cache key, session id and agent id were verified stable, so this is volatile content, not a key miss. RESOLVED 2026-09-20: PR #373 (merge 9e48b8d8; fix 4efb2915 'dedupe pre-edit grounding on record identity so a delivery receipt cannot re-send the full block', test a8675788) shipped in 1.40.0; test/hook-dedupe-stability.test.ts guards it.
evidence: 2026-09-19 subagent transcripts: 169 full injections (avg 3833 chars) vs 162 deltas; 63 of the fulls (37%) were repeats for the same agent+file

transcript 1bb0f7f4-.../subagents/agent-adedcf1f7826eb7ad.jsonl lines 54 and 60, two fulls 8 s apart for src/extractors/k8sManifest.ts: unified diff has exactly one differing line, the supplemental/recent-task reason '— today' vs '— delivered today'; the following 11 injections were deltas
Not individually diffed: the 6-full case on src/cli/index.ts; other volatile fields may contribute
